question: What independently testable residual does the proposed UD harmonic port add after a two-dimensional graphite PES and passive loss are controlled?
assumptions: seven-orbit projected incidence source with physical edge weights not yet determined
additive passive linear bath for local response
physical_mapping: S(w) to material coupling C=S(w)R remains hypothesized; no independently sourced graphite R,K,D_h/contact
target_exposure: 21.8/38.2 degree peaks and weak load dependence known before paper; seven-index source proposal is target-informed
fitted_choices: selection of seven quotient after observed angle; no kinetic parameter fitted
sources: Chen et al. PRL 137 166201 public abstract, DOI 10.1103/ly48-b4l2
UD-Physics merged graphite controls at base 5fd737f
supplied UD coefficient ledger v0.39(2) Q22 and Q77-Q84
baseline: 2D first-star three-equal-relaxer passive null plus independently calibrated 2D conservative PES/contact
result: No parameter-free UD residual. Conventional control gives conditional low-speed N7/N13 coefficient ratio 651175/6877 from rounded DFT and first directional power term order v6.
next_discriminant: Independently source material coupling and complex loss plus contact; freeze signed held-out force/load forecast at paired angles and N13 control.
